original_ci_failure.assertion: MUC controls room was not created with owner affiliation
original_ci_failure.limitation: The actual controls_created frame was not logged. The recorded server Some(owner) observation and later database moderator/owner row do not establish which frame the fixture selected or the original failure's cause.

source_finding.old_selection_at_base_commit: scripts/integration-wsl.py:5265 calls receive_until("code='110'"); receive_until at 2447-2464 accepts any frame containing that substring.
source_finding.demonstrated_problem: A constructed in-memory queue containing another room's self-presence before the controls-room response causes the old selector to return the unrelated frame. This demonstrates source-level selection imprecision, not the order or contents of the original CI trace.
source_finding.success_correlation: src/xmpp/protocol/muc.rs:4758-4766 passes root.attribute("id").or(cluster_event_id.as_deref()) to the joining occupant's self-presence, preserving a provided request id. src/xmpp/xml_util.rs:417-460 emits jabber:client presence with exact room/nickname from, that id, self-presence code 110, and creation code 201 when created.
source_finding.error_correlation: src/xmpp/xml_util.rs:550-575 builds a presence error whose from is the request to and whose id is the request id.
source_finding.import_review: integration-wsl.py performs environment reads and defines functions/classes at import; run() and the endpoint self-test are inside the __main__ guard. The regression imports it without executing either entry point.

change.scope: Only the controls-room join path in the ordinary integration fixture uses the new helper. This exact fixture-change file list does not modify CI, Rust or SQL. Concurrent Stage1 work separately adds pure-test CI wiring; it is excluded from this small commit.
change.selection: Send the fixture-unique muc-controls-owner-join id, then require a jabber:client presence root with that exact id and from equal to integration-controls@conference.<domain>/Alice.
change.validation: Require available self-presence, code 110, code 201 and a MUC-user item with owner affiliation. A correlated error or invalid creation reply fails immediately even when a valid-looking reply follows.
change.diagnostics: Preserve the original assertion text and include expected full from/id plus all observed frames. Timeout, EOF and connection errors retain frames and chained causes. The receive budget remains ten seconds and decreases across ignored frames.
change.rollback: Revert this fixture-only change and its regression test; there is no schema or operations change.
change.diagnostic_scope: These existing-style observed frame diagnostics are not claimed to be sanitized causal evidence; they remain local synthetic integration diagnostics.

coverage: Old substring selection accepts the unrelated room's code 110; corrected selection waits for the actual controls reply
Exact root stanza kind/namespace, full room/nickname from, and root request id
Valid XML with double quotes and namespace prefixes
Same-room correlated error, wrong owner, missing/wrong code 201, missing code 110, unavailable presence and wrong MUC namespace fail immediately
Timeout, EOF and connection-error diagnostics preserve all observed frames
Ignored frames consume one fixed ten-second receive deadline

checks.check: Python ast.parse syntax checks for integration-wsl.py and test-integration-muc-matching.py

execution_limits.transport: XmppWebSocket allocated through object.__new__ with send/receive mocks; fake monotonic clock; no constructor or real transport.
execution_limits.conclusion: This record qualifies only the fixture matcher regression. It does not establish the failed CI job's cause, prove a product defect was fixed, or provide live integration evidence.
